scope: Bounded alternate endpoint capability observation and offline HTTP error diagnostics
limitations: The preserved legacy observation records RuntimeError only; no numeric HTTP status or raw HTTP response can be recovered from it.
The legacy shared meter converts upstream HTTPError to RuntimeError without structured status. This is a known diagnostic loss path, not evidence for an invented status code.
Chain ID was not verified; tracing/archive support at this endpoint remains unknown. No admission/index entry is created.
New typed status handling is tested offline only; old raw artifacts are preserved unchanged and no retry was made.
offline_fix: RuntimeError-compatible UpstreamHTTPError carries only validated integer http_status. New probes may persist that number and exception type, never URL, headers, body or arbitrary error text.
